answer_1.quote: We involve four sets of benchmarks to evaluate ZOOTER on various downstream tasks... AlpacaEval, FLASK, MT-Bench, MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval... The ensemble aims to merge off-the-shelf LLMs to perform better consistently across diverse downstream tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses from each candidate LLM

answer_2.quote: We report win rate between evaluated models and text-davinci-003 measured by GPT-4... We report accuracy on MMLU and GSM8K, and Pass@1 on the HumanEval. Rewards from off-the-shelf RMs are used as supervision.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 judge is used for AlpacaEval, FLASK, and MT-Bench. Reward model ranking (RMR) uses off-the-shelf reward models (OASSISTRM, AUTO-J, ULTRARM, QWENRM) to rank responses.
